sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会議案一覧

name: 市税の公示送達の方法を追加
summary: 市税の公示送達は、掲示場への掲示で行うことになっています。この議案では、公示事項を不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にする措置を加え、掲示場への掲示か、市の事務所にある電子計算機の画面で閲覧できる状態にする方法を組み合わせます。
changes: 公示事項を不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にする措置を加える
掲示場への掲示または市の事務所の電子計算機画面で閲覧できる状態にする
who: 市から公示送達を受ける人
why: 地方税法等の一部を改正する法律の公布によるものと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Adds another method for public notice of city taxes
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Tachikawa City Ordinance on the Assessment and Collection of City Taxes
en.summary: Service by public notice for city taxes is currently carried out by posting notices on a notice board. The bill adds a measure to make the matters being publicly announced available for viewing by an unspecified number of people, and combines this with either posting on a notice board or making them viewable on a computer screen at a city office.
changes: Adds a measure to make publicly announced matters available for viewing by an unspecified number of people, using either a notice board or a computer screen at a city office
who: People who receive service by public notice from the city concerning city taxes
en.why: The city says this is due to the promulgation of the Act Partially Amending the Local Tax Act, etc.
